text: SOLUTION (a) f"(7) = 0 since the degree 3 term does not appear in P5(z). (b) You get it just by truncation; i.e., drop off the terms you don't want, so Py(z) = 2+ 3(z — 7) + %(z —7)%+ %(z -7t (c) Just plug in to P5(z): f(7+0.1) = P5(7+0.1) = 243((7T+01) = 7)+ 3((T+01) = 7) + 2 ((7T+0.1) = 7)* + L((7T+0.1) = 7)° = 2+3(0.1) + 2(0.1)% + £ (0.1)* + % (0.1)°. (d) h(z) = 2+ 3(z — 7); i.e, take the first two terms of Ps(x).
